Description:
Brand: SMC

DESCRIPTION: AW20(*)-B to AW60(*)-B, Filter Regulator & Filter Regulator w/Backflow Function
PROPERTIES/VALUES: Made to Order 1: None Body Size: 40 Backflow Function: None Thread: F (G) Port: 04 (1/2) Option: BDE (w/Bracket + Float Type Auto Drain [N.O.] + Square embedded type pressure gauge [with limit indicator]) Semi-standard 1: Standard Semi-standard 2: Standard Made to Order 2: None
LONG DESCRIPTION: This combination Filter/ Regulator minimizes space and piping by integrating the 2 units into one. Standard features include a relieving regulator, which can be quickly locked by pushing down on the adjustment knob. There are many options, which include gauges, auto-drain, metal bowl and covers, different set pressures, etc. The AW-B is part of the family of modular air preparation units and can be combined with other similar sized products. This series is available in 3 body sizes with piping from 1/8 to 3/4 in Rc, NPT or G thread types. Integrated filter and regulator units save space and require less piping. With the backflow function it incorporates a mechanism to exhaust the air pressure in the outlet side reliably and quickly.
BULLET POINTS: Modular type filter regulator. Transparent bowl guard. Available with built-in backflow mechanism. Rc, G(PF) or NPT threads.

DESCRIPTION: AW20(*)-B to AW60(*)-B, Filter Regulator & Filter Regulator w/Backflow Function

LONG DESCRIPTION: This combination Filter/ Regulator minimizes space and piping by integrating the 2 units into one. Standard features include a relieving regulator, which can be quickly locked by pushing down on the adjustment knob. There are many options, which include gauges, auto-drain, metal bowl and covers, different set pressures, etc. The AW-B is part of the family of modular air preparation units and can be combined with other similar sized products. This series is available in 3 body sizes with piping from 1/8 to 3/4 in Rc, NPT or G thread types. Integrated filter and regulator units save space and require less piping. With the backflow function it incorporates a mechanism to exhaust the air pressure in the outlet side reliably and quickly.
BULLET POINTS: Modular type filter regulator. Transparent bowl guard. Available with built-in backflow mechanism. Rc, G(PF) or NPT threads.

This series is available in 3 body sizes with piping from 1/8 to 3/4 in Rc, NPT or G thread types. Integrated filter and regulator units save space and require less piping. With the backflow function it incorporates a mechanism to exhaust the air pressure in the outlet side reliably and quickly.
